WEST PAKISTAN FISHERIES RULES, 1965
WEST PAKISTAN FISHERIES RULES, 1965
(Amendments)
[Gazette of West Pakistan, Part I, 9th December 1966]
No. 4 (107) S. O. (F & G)/64.-In exercise of the powers
conferred by section 26 of the West Pakistan Fisheries Ordinance, 1961
(Ordinance XXX of 1965), the Governor of West Pakistan is pleased to direct
that in the West Pakistan Fisheries Rules, 1965, the following amendments shall
be made, namely:
1. In rule 3, for the words, figures and commas "Appendices
I, III, IV and V", the words, figures and commas "Appendices I, II,
III, IV and V" shall be substituted.
2. In rule 5, for the words, figures and commas "Appendices
I, III, IV", and V" the words, figures and commas "Appendices I,
II, III, IV and V shall be substituted.
3. In rule 10, for the word " of " occurring between the
Word "rule" and the word "may", the figures "7"
shall be substituted.
4. In Appendix IV, the full-stop appearing at the end shall be
replaced by a comma, and thereafter the following shall be added, namely:-
"(xvii) Himatpura Fish Farm, Lyallpur."
5. In Appendix VI-
(i) the words and brackets "except waters mentioned in Part
-V (b) and (c)" shall be deleted; and
(ii) for the words "and Dera Ismail Khan" the words
"Dera Ismail Khan and Dera Ghazi Khan" shall be substituted.
